book.title: Malobhi Manyahi ngati moghalembakike na Yohana

content: Yesu na bhalongu bhaki
Paghajomwiki ghanihagha Yesu akabhi ajenda mu Galilaya, ndandi ngacheapaliki kujenda mu Yudea, kwa ndandi bhakolongwa bha Bhayahude bhakabhi bhalonda kunkoma.
Na chikahi cha uwangalalu wa Bhayahude, Uwangalalu wa Indamba, chakabhi chiheghalile.
Bhela bhalongu bhaka Yesu bhakumpwaghile, “Ubhoka pambane, na ujenda ku Yudea, nahuli bhabhulwa bhaku nabhombi bhapata kughabhona mahengu ghaku ghaughahenga.
Nga mundu joatenda mambu kwa kulihiya, na koni mweni apala kumanyikana. Ngati anauhenga mambu aghagha, bhela ulilangihaje wamwete pundema wokapi.”
Kwa ndandi hata bhalongu bhaki ngachebhunhobhalile.
Bhela Yesu akabhapwaghile, “Chenjenu nga chikahi changu chechipalika, nambu kwinu mwehapa chikahi chokapi chipalika.
Bhandu bha pundema ngabhawezi kunhakalila mwehapa, nambu bhanhakalila nepani, kwa ndandi nepani nabhalandila kubha matendu ghabhu nde mahakau.
Nkwelaje mwehapa njendanyaje mkakula uwangalalu. Nepani nga ngweli nakona kujenda kula uwangalalu hoghu, kwa ndandi chikahi changu chekimbalila chakali ngachechihikike.”
Paakajomwi kubhapwaghi malobhi ghanihagha, akajendali kutama mu Galilaya.
Yesu ku Uwangalalu wa Indamba
Hata bhalongu bhaki pabhajomwili kukwela kujenda ku Uwangalalu wa Indamba, na Yesu akakweliki kujenda ku uwangalalu, nga kwa kubhonikana, nambu ngati kwa kulihiya.
Bhela bhakolongwa bha Bhayahude bhakundondiki pa uwangalalu, bhakapwaghaje, “Bho, abhi kwako mundu jola?”
Kukabhi na kujojalanela kwamaheli pa lipogha la bhandu panani jaki jombi. Na bhangi bhakapwaghike, “Mundu hoju nde wambone.” Bhandu bhangi bhakapwaghike, “Ngabhela, nambu abhakolowa bhandu.”
Nambu nga mundu joakumpwaghiki Yesu palanga, kwa ndandi ja kubhajoghopa bhakolongwa bha Bhayahude.
Pajahika pakati ja uwangalalu Yesu akakweliki na kujingila mu liwangala la Nyumba jaka Chapanga, na kutumbula kubhola.
Bhakolongwa bha Bhayahude bhakakangichi bhakapwaghaje, “Bho, mundu ajoju apatiki bhole kumanya mambu aghagha, koni ngacheasomike?”
Bhela Yesu akabhayangiki, na kupwagha, “Mabholu ghangu nga ghangu namwete, nambu ghaka jombi joandumike.
Mundu anaapaliki kughahenga mapalu ghaka Chapanga, anaamanyaje kubha mabholu ghangu ghahuma kwaka Chapanga, au nepani nongela kwa ndandi jangu namwete.
Jola joalongela kwa ndandi jaki mweni pela alonda lujiniku lwaki mweni. Nambu jola joalonda lujiniku lwaka jola joantumiki, jonihoju nde wa chakaka, na wala mkati jaki njeta uhakau.
Bho, Musa ngacheakumpeki Shelia? Nambu njeta hata jumu winu joajikamula Shelia heji. Bho, maghambu kiki mpala kungoma?”
Bhandu bhakayangike, “Wehapa ubhi na majobhi! Bho, nane joapala kukukoma?”
Yesu akabhayangike, “Nepani nakahengiki ngangachu jimu, na mwehapa mabhokapi mkangacha.
Musa akumpeki malaghalakilu gha jando, nambu nga ngati ghahuma kwaka Musa, nambu kwa akahokolu, nanamu munheketa mundu jandu hata mu Lichobha la Sabato.
Bhela ngati anakubhi mundu aheketa jandu hata mu Lichobha la Sabato nahuli Shelia jaka Musa ngajihika kuhekateka, bho, mbona muhyomela nepani kwa ndandi nakundamihi mundu mu Lichobha la Sabato?
Nkotukaje kutemula mambu kwa kulingalila kwa kunja pela, nambu mughalingaje mambu na kutemula kwa chakaka.”
Bho, hajoju le nde Kristo?
Bhela bhandu bhakumu bha ku Yelusalemu bhakapwaghike, “Bho, hajoju le nga mundu jola ambaju ihongozi bhundonda nahuli bhunkomaje?”
Lingalyaje, abhi pambane! Akalongilaje palanga, wala ngachebhumpwaghi lilobhi lokapi lela. Bho, iwezikana kubha chakaka ihongozi abhabha bhamanyi kubha hajoju nde Kristo?
Nambu hajoju tummanyi koahuma, nambu Kristo paanahikaje, nga mundu joamanya koahuma.

Bhela Yesu akajamalili sauti jaki mu liwangala la Nyumba jaka Chapanga, akabholaje na kupwagha, “Bho, nepani mmanye, na konhuma hoku mkumanye? Wala nepani ngachenhikiki kwa ndandi ja lujiniku lwangu namwete, nambu jombi joandumike nde wa chakaka, jwangakummanya mwehapa.
Nambu nepani nummanyi jombi, kwa ndandi nhumiki kwaki, najombi nde joandumike.”
Bhela bhandu bhakalondiki kunkamula, nambu nga mundu joakahatambwili chiwoku chaki nahuli kunkamula, kwa ndandi lisaa laki lakabhi likali ngakuhika.
Bhandu bhamaheli pa uwangalalu pala bhakunhobhalile, na bhakapwaghike, “Bho, Kristo paanahikaje, anahenga nginyulila yamaheli nakanopi kupeta yeahengiki mundu ajojo?”
Manjolinjoli bhatumakika kunkamula Yesu

Mafalisayo bhakabhajowini bhandu bhakang'ong'utikaje malobhi ghanihagha panani jaka Yesu, bhela bhapenganyambiku bhakolongwa papamu na Mafalisayo bhakabhatumiki bhalonda bha Nyumba jaka Chapanga nahuli bhakunkamulaje.
Bhela Yesu akabhapwaghile, “Nakona mili na mwehapa kwa chikahi kichokopi pela, na bhela ananyendaje kwaka jola joandumike.
Mwinonda nepani, wala ngamwimone, na nepani pamile mwehapa ngachemuweza kuhika.”
Bhela bhakolongwa bha Bhayahude bhakapwaghanile, “Bho, hajoju anajenda kwaku, hata tepani ngatumbona? Bho, apala kujenda ku michi ja Bhagiliki kobhaghabhaniki Bhayahude, na kubhabhola Bhagiliki?
Bho, nde lilobhi bhole leniheli lealilongile, ‘Anamunonda nambu ngamwimone, wala nepani pamile mwehapa ngamuwezi kuhika?’ ”
Mikoka ja machi gha womi
Pa lichobha la kujomukela, lichobha lela likolongwa la uwangalalu, Yesu akajemiki, na kujamalila, akapwaghaje, “Mundu joabhona inywita, ahikaje kwangu nepani, na akunywaje.
Ngati moghapwaghi Malembu Mahuhu kubha, ‘Jola joanhobhalela nepani, mikoka ja machi ghaghabhi womi anajipitaje kuhuma mkati jaki.’ ”

Yesu akalilongi lilobhi leniheli kubhokana na Roho Mhuhu, ambaju bhala bhabhunhobhalela anabhunjopalyaje, kwa ndandi Roho Mhuhu akabhi akali ngakuhika, na maghambu Chapanga akabhi akali ngakuuyekula ulumbalilu waka Yesu.
Kulekangana pachilanda ja bhandu
Bhela bhandu bhangi pa uhangalalu pala pabhakajowini malobhi ghanihagha, bhakapwaghike, “Chakaka hajoju nde jola Mlota waka Chapanga.”
Bhangi bhakapwaghike, “Hajoju nde Kristo.” Nambu bhangi bhakapwaghike, “Bho, Kristo aweza bhole kuhuma ku Galilaya?
Bho, Malembu Mahuhu ngacheghapwagha, ‘Kristo anahikaje kuhuma mu lubheleku lwaka Nkolongwa Daude, na kuhuma ku Beselehemu, na muchi ghola ghoatamika Daude?’ ”
Bhela kukapitali na kulekangana pachilanda ja lipogha la bhandu kwa ndandi jaka Yesu.
Bhakumu bhabhu bhakapaliki kunkamula, nambu nga mundu joakalengiki kuhatambula chiwoku chaki nahuli kunkamula.
Kukotoka kuhobhalela kwa bhakolongwa bha Bhayahude
Bhela bhalonda bhala bhakabhajendili ihongozi bha bhapenganyambiku na Mafalisayo. Nabhombi bhakabhapwaghile, “Bho, mbona ngachemundetiki Yesu?”
Bhalonda bhala bhakabhayangike, “Nga mundu jokapi joalabhali kulongela ngati mundu hajoju!”
Bhela Mafalisayo bhakabhayangike, “Bho, mwehapa nanamu atehi kunkolowa?
Bho, ndabhali le kumbona chiongozi jokapi jola wa Bhayahude joanhobhalela, au pachilanda ja Mafalisayo?
Ngabhela! Nambu bhandu abhabha bhangakujimanya Shelia jaka Musa bhabhili na masolu!”
Panihapa Nikodemu, jola joakabhi anjendili Yesu lichobha limu ikilu, ambaju akabhi jumu wabhu, akabhapwaghile,
“Bho, Shelia jitu juntemu mundu panga na kunjowanela hote, na kumanya cheahengike?”
Bhakamuyangike, na kumpwaghila, “Bho, wehapa nanau uhumiki ku Galilaya? Ulondaje na anaubhonaje kubha nga mlota waka Chapanga joahuma ku Galilaya.”
Bhela, kila jumu akabhujiki kunyumba jaki.
